# graviteeam_alert_trigger (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM alert trigger

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_domain" "example" {
  name        = "alert-trigger-domain"
  description = "Example domain"

  oidc {}
  login_settings {}
}

resource "graviteeam_alert_trigger" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  type      = "TOO_MANY_LOGIN_FAILURES"
  enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `type` (String) The alert trigger type: TOO_MANY_LOGIN_FAILURES or RISK_ASSESSMENT

### Optional

- `alert_notifier_ids` (Set of String) Set of alert notifier IDs used by this trigger
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert trigger is enabled

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Terraform ID of the alert trigger
